channel.title: The Awesome Ledger — awesome-scientific-writing
channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: rumdl — via awesome-scientific-writing
item.description: Fast Markdown linter and formatter written in Rust, with built-in support for several "flavors" such as GFM, MkDocs, MyST, Quarto etc.

item.title: mdformat — via awesome-scientific-writing
item.description: Opinionated CommonMark-compliant Markdown formatter. Enforces consistent style (indentation, ATX headings, link references at bottom). Supports CommonMark by default, with plugins for GFM, tables, footnotes, admonitions, MyST, MkDocs, and more.

item.title: citecheck — via awesome-scientific-writing
item.description: Command-line tool that matches BibTeX, RIS, and CSL-JSON references against Crossref and OpenAlex and flags retractions reported by Crossref.

item.title: latex2arxiv — via awesome-scientific-writing
item.description: Command-line tool which converts a LaTeX project into an arXiv-ready ZIP: prunes unused files, strips comments and draft markup, and flags arXiv submission blockers before upload.

item.title: Zotero OCR — via awesome-scientific-writing
item.description: Plugin that makes scanned PDFs searchable using Tesseract OCR and Poppler.

item.title: Typst — via awesome-scientific-writing
item.description: Markup-based typesetting system with math, bibliography management, and fast incremental compilation to PDF.

item.title: ScholarRef — via awesome-scientific-writing
item.description: Convert citation styles (APA 7, Harvard, Vancouver) directly inside Word .docx files.

item.title: MyST Markdown CLI — via awesome-scientific-writing
item.description: Command-line tools for building scientific documents from MyST Markdown with citations, cross-references, and HTML, PDF, and Word output.

item.title: Manubot — via awesome-scientific-writing
item.description: Workflow for writing and publishing scholarly manuscripts with Markdown, persistent-identifier citations, and reproducible builds.
